Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5728477. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
